I independently expanded the formula in SymPy and simplified BOTH coefficients exactly, not from verifier logs. The historical global theorem that only six opposite-edge directions attain W*=√3−1/√2 is expressly a cited external premise; Finch reports this extremum. Numerical angular quadrature is not the global proof. The O(ε³) follows from analytic local formulas and isolated compact maximizers.
